The scammers want you to log into their website, FedExpfm.com tell you they couldn’t deliver a package. They are impersonating the real FedEx company. Once you login, they have your information and they’ll ask you for a small amount of money and then they’ll steal all your credit card information and money.

I purchased the product after seeing an ad on Instagram and I never received the order. I know there are ads on TikTok, too. No one has responded to my customer service emails seeking a refund.

The marketing ad shown a crisp clear projection of different moving images like the night sky or the sea. After receiving the product the projector shown a stationary picture, blurry, and did not show moving images.
I asked for a refund with no response.

I received two phone calls from the number 800-240-8151 which showed up as my bank, Fifth Third.  I called to see what was needed and went through the usual Fifth Third phone protocol but went to a call center and spoke with a male who said his name was Srah, who told me that I had an outstanding balance owed of $3,820.10 overdraft on my account.  He took my information such as address, social security, phone number, etc.  When I checked my overdraft protection credit card balance and saw that the number was different, I went to my bank to check on this.  They told me my account was fine, and that this number he used, 800-240-8151 was not one of their numbers.
I am wondering what I can do to protect myself, as I unfortunately gave sensitive information to this scammer, thinking it was my actual bank.
Thank you for any assistance you can provide.

I ordered from them 3 times, these were small bottle that had liquid, which was supposed to be dark brown liquid, but I didnt know this until I made the last order. When I got it I immediately open it up and saw it was much lighter then the first and second set. I called and told them, but as expected, they denied it, so I took a picture and sent it to them, and they said I could sent it back, and I did, which cost me $17 more dollars. I got a notion they had received it on the 19th of November 2026 and today’s date is 23th of November 2026, looks like I have to call my bank. People watch out, lots of scammers out there.
